channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: University study claims men ‘may not have fitness advantage’ against women
item.description: A University of Sao Paulo study challenges the belief that trans women have a fitness advantage over biological women in sports. It found comparable fitness levels post-hormone therapy, questioning blanket bans on trans women in athletics. Critics argue the study's data quality and design were poor, highlighting the need for nuanced eligibility criteria in sports.

item.title: Gen Z will go out to protest ICE … but won’t shovel snow for cash
item.description: Dave Huber reflects on the stark contrast between past and present youth behavior regarding responsibility. He emphasizes a perceived decline in personal accountability and critiques the media's portrayal of youth activism, suggesting a disconnect between traditional values and contemporary progressive ideologies.

item.title: Arkansas State U. protesters want ‘accountability’ following alleged racist incidents
item.description: Following alleged racist incidents at Arkansas State University, numerous student protesters demanded accountability and reform. They insisted on an independent investigation and new policies that uphold respect for students, urging administrators not to use the First Amendment as justification for derogatory speech.

item.title: U. Minnesota activist students chain themselves to building, chant ‘f*ck ICE, ICE out!’
item.description: Four University of Minnesota students chained themselves to Morrill Hall, demanding the university be declared a sanctuary campus and a cutting of ties with ICE. Their protest included chanting and calls for an official statement against ICE presence. The demonstration ended after police arrested three students.

item.title: Oklahoma governor ends tenure at most public universities
item.description: The four-page order grandfathers in those who already have tenure and applies to future hires.

item.title: UMN professor allegedly conducted ‘ICE drill’ in class, had students shield ‘targeted’ peers: report
item.description: A University of Minnesota professor, Blanca Caldas, reportedly conducted an "ICE drill" in her class where students were instructed to shield peers perceived as targets during a mock scenario involving ICE agents. Some students felt uncomfortable with the exercise, questioning its racial implications, while the university is currently reviewing the situation.

item.title: UNL delivers 50 termination notices amid budgets cuts, chancellor’s contested $1.1M payout
item.description: Bennett's decision came after a no-confidence vote from the UNL faculty senate, whose members have said they felt the cuts by Bennett were especially bitter given his big payout.

item.title: Half of Gen Z brings parents to job interviews: survey
item.description: A January survey revealed that over 50% of college-age job seekers had their parents attend interviews, with many parents also performing tasks like writing cover letters.

item.title: Cal Poly fires chemistry lecturer after raising concerns about foreign hires: report
item.description: She raised concerns about foreign workers and lab safety. Then the school declined to rehire her.

item.title: Harvard faculty propose capping A grades to combat inflation
item.description: Students have said they are against the proposal.
